Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 4, 2026

Welcome to the privacy policy of WearBridge. This application helps you connect your Wear OS device to the services or devices you choose. WearBridge is designed to operate without collecting personal information or using intermediary services.

1. Information We Do Not Collect

WearBridge does not collect, sell, or share personal data. We do not create user profiles and do not track your activity, location, or usage patterns.

2. Connection Data

Connection details and other information you provide in the app are used only to establish and maintain the connection you request. This information is not sent to us or stored on our servers.

3. Direct Communication

When WearBridge communicates with another device or service, the communication is sent to the destination you select. WearBridge does not operate a relay, proxy, or cloud service that receives or stores your connection data.

4. No Analytics or Monitoring

WearBridge does not use analytics, advertising trackers, crash reporting, or monitoring services that collect information about you or your use of the app.

5. Permissions

The app requests only the permissions needed for its connection features. Network access is used solely for communication with the destination you configure.

6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions, contact us at:
